name: Marlene Ríos
bio: Certified guide in Granada for 6 years. I love telling the stories that don't make it into the guidebooks.

reviews.author: Carlos M.
reviews.text: Marlene knows so much and is super friendly. The tour felt short.

reviews.author: Ana P.
reviews.text: She recommended places to eat that we didn't even know existed.

name: Esteban Vado
bio: Former history teacher, now a full-time guide. Specialist in colonial architecture and local legends. Also works as a translator when the group needs it.

reviews.author: Roberto T.
reviews.text: Very good historical knowledge, though the tour was a bit long.

name: Fátima Duarte
bio: Born and raised in León. I'm passionate about showing the living culture of the city: markets, street art and music.

reviews.author: Daniel K.
reviews.text: The best guide we've had in Central America, no exaggeration.

reviews.author: Mariana G.
reviews.text: Super punctual and full of energy the whole tour.

reviews.author: Luis F.
reviews.text: She made us feel like part of the city, not tourists.

name: Óscar Membreño
bio: Nature and volcano guide. If you're looking for adventure and you're in good shape for hiking, I'm your guide.

reviews.author: Patricia N.
reviews.text: He knows the terrain very well, and the sense of safety he gives you is much appreciated.

reviews.author: Jorge A.
reviews.text: Great hiking pace and lots of stories about the volcano.

name: Valeria Ortega
bio: Food guide: I take you to try what locals really eat, not just the touristy stuff.

reviews.author: Tom H.
reviews.text: Best food tour we've done in Nicaragua, hands down.

reviews.author: Karla S.
reviews.text: Very good selection of stalls, though a little tight on time.

name: Ramón Castillo
bio: Young, dynamic guide, always with good music to liven up the group tour.

reviews.author: Diego R.
reviews.text: Great vibe, and he helped us take incredible photos.

reviews.author: Emily W.
reviews.text: Fun and easygoing, great for a casual group tour.

name: Hans Berger
bio: Certified translator. I'm not a tour guide: I work alongside local guides to translate in real time. I've lived in Nicaragua for 8 years.

reviews.author: Werner K.
reviews.text: Flawless translation, we understood the whole tour perfectly.

reviews.author: Julia S.
reviews.text: Very professional, although we prefer it when the guide also speaks some German.

name: Noemí Vaz
bio: Freelance translator. I work alongside local guides for groups that don't speak Spanish. I don't lead tours on my own.

reviews.author: Marco B.
reviews.text: Perfect, she helped us understand every detail of the tour.

reviews.author: Beatriz F.
reviews.text: Excellent translator, very attentive and punctual.
